newsitem.title: USA: Home Depot reports record net; stock falls.
newsitem.headline: Home Depot reports record net; stock falls.

text.p: Home Depot Inc. said Tuesday its earnings jumped 26 percent to a record high in the latest quarter, but the company's stock fell as the results were in line with Wall Street's expectations.

The nation's largest home improvement retailer said it earned $221 million, or 46 cents a share, in its fiscal third quarter ended on Oct. 27. That compared with year-ago earnings of $175 million, or 37 cents a share.
The Atlanta-based company said sales rose 23 percent to $5.0 billion, compared with $4.0 billion a year ago. Sales at stores opened for a year were up 7 percent.
Industry analysts were expecting earnings of 46 cents a share.
Home Depot's stock fell $2.125 to $54.625 on the New York Stock Exchange.
